list: All 55 official PlayStation 5 trophies — names, descriptions and grades from the official list. 28 of the 55 stay hidden on PS5 until they are earned.

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
sources.what: The official list — every trophy's name, description and grade.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.what: The platinum roadmap: 4/10 difficulty, about 200 hours, the one possibly-missable trophy and the 100% checklist.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
sources.what: Unlock tips per trophy, story chapters, hidden flags and the 100% completion requirements.

sources.name: gta-zone — GTA 6 Trophy List
sources.what: The full 55-trophy list, the platinum roadmap and the missable warning.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
sources.what: The PSN progress targets — the counts PlayStation tracks — for the trophies that have one.

steps.title: Play the story, take side content as it shows up
steps.text: Play through the five chapters and pick up optional missions and character quests as they show up. Along the way, scan vehicles with the WAiNK app (200 are needed for 100%), study animals with binoculars (100), meditate with both characters, and switch on every progress and collectible notification. In Chapter 1, don't skip Lucia's balcony meditation — it may be missable. Stay away from the Irredeemable criminal profile: it's permanent. Cheats switch off trophies and saving, so leave them off. There's no mission replay and no New Game+, but free roam keeps going after the story.

steps.title: Finish the 100% Completion checklist
steps.text: Once the credits roll, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work through what's left: every robbery, all 8 bank vaults and all 39 gang operations, the underwater discoveries, every Shooting Range gold medal, all drone races and Bret's 15 Target Decks, plus 70 of the 80 challenges. The checklist is forgiving — nearer 60% true completion — and everything you did during the story already counts. Nothing on it can be missed.

steps.title: Strangers & Freaks and clean-up
steps.text: Stranger missions aren't part of 100%, but Strangers & Freaks needs 8 strands, and several trophies come from character quest lines (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret). Finish those, then check the list for anything left.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one is yours — there is no separate task behind it. PowerPyx rates the set 4/10 and about 200 hours, and most of that time sits behind A Long Road's 100% checklist. A single playthrough is enough, everything is single-player, and with no mission replay you play the story once and finish the rest in free roam.

source.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, one of Chapter 1's opening missions, and this pops. Pure story — just play the opening.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Awarded for completing Chapter 1 — GTABase notes it actually unlocks when the first Chapter 2 mission, What's in the Bag?, begins, so don't worry if it doesn't appear the moment the chapter closes. Keep playing and it arrives on its own.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: The Chapter 2 completion trophy. GTABase notes it unlocks as Chapter 3 begins, after the Welcome to Vice City mission, so a short delay after the chapter ends is normal.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: For completing Chapter 3. GTABase notes it lands after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Story progress only — nothing to miss.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: For completing Chapter 4. A straight story trophy — play through the chapter and it pops; it can't be missed.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Awarded for the story's final mission — the last thing you do in Chapter 5. Free roam keeps going after the credits, so the rest of the list can still be finished then, and no trophy hinges on how you play a mission.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: For Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 mission. It pops when the mission ends — nothing extra is needed, and it can't be missed.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: For The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 mission. Finish the heist and the trophy follows.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: For Child's Play, a Chapter 4 mission. Complete the mission and it pops.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: For Headliners, a Chapter 4 mission. Finish the mission; it can't be missed.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: For VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 mission. Complete the takedown and the trophy is yours.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: For Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 mission. Finish it and the trophy pops.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The toughest trophy in the set, and the real gate to the platinum: the 100% Completion checklist, which appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion once the story is done. Anything you finished before the credits already counts toward it, and nothing on it can be missed. It is a forgiving checklist — nearer 60% true completion, per PowerPyx. It asks for every robbery in full, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, every underwater discovery, all Shooting Range gold medals, all drone races and Bret's 15 Target Decks, plus portions of the rest: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans. Set aside roughly 100 hours for this step alone.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts will do, in whatever mix: 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Under-bridge flights are the fastest way to rack up the total, and you don't need the optional challenge on each stunt. Your count is under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and the map can mark every Stunt Spot. The 100% checklist asks for 300, so don't stop at 250.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink a single basket), an arcade game, winning a race (a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race) and a stunt. Progress > Activities shows what's still undone, and most of these happen on their own while you play.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 gold medals across 12 ranges. Ranges also lift your Focus level, which helps toward Gunslinger, so it's worth doing them early.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — a single win at each is enough for this trophy. The 100% checklist asks for all 42 drone races, so you may as well clear each location while you're there.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — there are 40 to pick from, and repeat wins don't count. Any mix of car races, race challenges and drone races works.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui; he'll text you afterward and mark a fishing spot with a purple icon. Work through his fishing quests and beat him in his challenge.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game. Three of them — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind — are on the TV at home; the fourth, Bang For Your Buck, is on arcade cabinets around Leonida.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's quests are Lucia-only and begin in Chapter 3, when he texts her an address in Belville. Do all five in order — Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the last one awards the trophy. They're still there after the story.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton, marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento, hires you in Chapter 1 to recover treasure from 7 shipwrecks. Dive at the purple chest markers and use the metal detector to dig it up. He vanishes after Chapter 1 but texts Jason again later, so you can finish it then. Track it under Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's five jobs begin at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County once the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break is done. Finish the fifth, Hometown Heroes, and the trophy unlocks; the jobs remain available after the story.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count; the quest lines of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie don't. The remaining qualifying strands are still being confirmed, so check the trophy's progress counter in your trophy list. None of them are needed for 100%, and all of them stay available after the story.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission that gets you the Key Cloner (Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS). Deliver the 16 sports cars on his list to his garage in west Vice City (RK icon). Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check whether they're on the list; hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are the best places to look, and cars in better condition pay more.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only. Once Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3 is done, Tyrone sends you after the synthetic labs marked in purple around Vice City. Destroy enough of them and his final job, Shut Down the Labs, hands you the trophy.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every Meditation Spot until the counter reaches 18 — meditating at a spot with Jason and Lucia together counts twice. The last one needs both characters, which is possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. POSSIBLY MISSABLE: in Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, follow Lucia from the kitchen to the balcony and accept her meditation. It is gone after Chapter 1, and it isn't confirmed yet whether the trophy needs it — so don't skip it. PowerPyx flags the same warning: this first meditation is the only possibly-missable moment in the game.

source.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's hunting quests start after Coffee Break in Chapter 2: he texts Jason, and Veteran Hunted in Lummox County kicks things off. Hunt the animals on his Target Decks (purple icons) and bring them back as Jason. A clean one-shot kill pays more but isn't required. Which animal triggers the trophy isn't confirmed yet; the 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks anyway.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 Collectible Card sets — you don't need all of them. The Collections section of the Progress menu shows how close each set is.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the WAiNK phone app — hold Up on the D-pad, then R1 / RB. Any 100 will do, drawn from the 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish 50 of the 80 Challenges — Progress > Challenges puts a tick next to finished ones. Plenty complete on their own while you play, and the 100% checklist asks for 70, so this one arrives along the way.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Possible once both characters are together, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Call your partner (hold Right on the D-pad, then Triangle / Y), get a 4-star Wanted Level and escape — it only counts once you're out of the red heat zone. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes off cops and helicopters well, and bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so it often unlocks there.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while you're still wanted (flashing red and blue). Go in with body armor, sticky bombs and healing items. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City — open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 — are close together. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to appear after the third shop; if it doesn't, rob a fourth.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app; you don't need to drive them. Stand next to a busy road and scan passing traffic. The 100% checklist needs 200 base models, so you'll get this anyway.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single Combat Focus (click both sticks while aiming). It only lasts a few seconds, so fill your Focus first — eat, drink or wash up at home; Adrenaline makes it last longer — and use an assault rifle. Gang operation thugs work well; cops, soldiers and civilians don't seem to count.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA, steal one of the big passenger jets docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge — planes parked out on the airfield don't count. Back it out, take off and get about 1 km away from the airport. Gates E3 and E4 are the easiest: drive through the airfield fence and use the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Take a tank from Mile Zero Air Station, on the southwest island of Mariana County — the tanks sit at the south end of the base — then take out enemies from inside it until the trophy pops.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 hand you the Snap Gun. Use it on a jewelry store's locked back door — kicking the door in trips the alarm — then find the note with the safe code in the back room and empty the safe without being spotted. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good pick.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Bank vaults open up with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…. Follow a security van to its bank and get into the vault while it's open. The haul is too heavy for one character, so hand a bag to your partner. Vaults always give 4 stars: escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles. 5 of the 8 vaults are enough here, but the 100% checklist needs all 8, and each pays up to $205,000. Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: A bank vault robbery counts here too (see Maximum Withdrawal), provided you then escape the red heat zone or reach a Pay 'n' Spray. Before vaults open up, you can box in an armored truck, stick a bomb on its back doors, blow them open and drive away.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Lift the fog from the entire map of Leonida. The fastest route is by plane — fly over every dark patch until the map is fully uncovered.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal gang operation — the yellow map icons — from each of the 9 gangs; Progress > Gangs keeps the tally. The 100% checklist asks for all 39.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail somewhere with a view on Ocean Beach in Vice City. GTABase still lists the exact steps as unconfirmed — the description points at a cocktail with a view, and players will pin down the method as they find it. Check the source link for updates.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The description points to smashing a car out through a vehicle showroom's window, in classic GTA style. GTABase still lists the exact steps as unconfirmed, so treat this as a lead to test rather than a finished method, and check the source link for updates.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a gang operation, first marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2. Take its three valuables: the luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the northeast table and the safe in the northeast hallway (bring sticky bombs). The trophy pops once you lose the police. You don't need all three in one visit, but the robbery takes a long time to come back.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia — Jason & Lucia > Strength in the pause menu. Train at fitness clubs (Map > Activities) with your partner along: working out with one trains the other as well. After the story you can also train at home.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Most players get it without trying; turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI to watch the count. Don't push towards the Irredeemable profile: it's permanent.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm points to succeeding at something on a second try. GTABase still lists the exact steps as unconfirmed — the description is the only lead so far, and players will pin down the method as they find it. Check the source link for updates.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Expect some strange event or Easter egg hidden in Leonida. GTABase still lists the exact steps as unconfirmed; the description is the only lead, so keep an eye out for odd encounters while exploring, and check the source link for updates.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The description points to knocking people over with a melee attack from a vehicle — a melee drive-by. GTABase still lists the exact steps as unconfirmed, so the description's wording is the lead for now; check the source link for updates.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) in Chapter 3 gets you the Dye Pack Jammer. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then sell the marked bills to fences; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. It's a running total, so the robberies for 100% get you there.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a running total of $100,000 across every kind of shop. Guns, car mods and tattoos burn through it fastest.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy the 8 garages for sale in the Vice City Real Estate phone app (available after Daily Driver in Chapter 2), about $160,000 in total. The 4 garages the story gives you don't count.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Moses' Chapter 2 mission gives you the Scooter Bros app. Take stolen vehicles to his garage in Port Gellhorn, respray them and register them. At first he only accepts cars without trackers; from Chapter 3, any Pay 'n' Spray can register tracked ones. You'll need free garage space (see Little Boxes), and each registration costs money, so stick to cheap cars and bikes.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
